basic_info.description: Welcome to 274 Lowell Street, nestled in the highly coveted Crocker Amazon neighborhood. This updated home features a living room with a fireplace, a kitchen, three bedrooms, and a full bath on the main level. The lower level boasts a permitted family room, an additional bedroom, a playroom, a full bathroom, and a separate entrance - ideal for extended family, guests, or potential rental income. Other features include a dedicated laundry room, a bonus half-bath, and a one-car garage on the lower level. The house offers city views, original hardwood floors, double-pane windows, copper pipes, and a low-maintenance backyard.
